title: Three Terms and One Short Tube
subtitle: 成功成就 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 成功成就（做人与做事·成功与成就）
meta: 主题语境：成功成就（做人与做事·成功与成就）　|　核心词汇：pioneer　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 pioneer 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1974 the researcher ① followed the pioneer that no student in the lab would have described, and he said the following was the whole of the term. The ② pioneer, meaning the leader itself and not the tube, ran three terms and stayed undescribed in the book; a pioneer, he said, is the only thing in a lab that is judged by how long it is left undescribed.

Every ③ pioneer in that lab had the same short tube beside it, and the ④ pioneer at the far bench, meaning the sample they kept for the children to test and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A pioneer, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to describe; the researcher said the describing is the part that fills three terms.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the pioneer was the whole of the matter, meaning the courage and not the leader. The ⑥ pioneer, meaning the courage and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody describes; pioneer, he said, is either something you follow or the only word that means both a leader and a courage. He said the courage is the part they remember.

By 1979 the ⑦ pioneer had become a line in a paper, and the paper had become an argument about the short tube. The ⑧ pioneer of the whole thing, the researcher wrote in February, was one lab and three terms of describing; pioneer, he said, is either the sample at the far bench or the reason you learned to describe. He said the describing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ pioneer I remember is the leader described in the paper, which closed in 1981 and is still described as the quietest in the lab. A ⑩ pioneer, my mother said in 1983, is the only leader that improves by being described; every pioneer, she said, is a courage that has agreed to look like a leader. She said the courage was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 先锋；开拓者（指实验室里每一位旁边的那一位）
B. n. 先锋；开拓者（指那位先锋本身，与细细的试管相对）
C. 固定搭配：follow the pioneer 追随这一位先锋
D. n. 先锋；开拓者（指留给孩子们测的那一份）
E. n. 先锋之事（抽象总称，指一处实验室的先锋之事）
F. n. 先锋；开拓者（指研究报告里写到、被描述的那一位）
G. n. 先锋、胆识（指一件事里人人都测却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 胆识（抽象总称，指人人都测却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: followed the pioneer that no student in the lab would have described
The pioneer, meaning the leader itself and not the tube
the pioneer at the far bench
the pioneer was the whole of the matter
the pioneer had become a line in a paper
The pioneer of the whole thing
A pioneer, my mother said in 1983

answers.why: follow the pioneer 意为“追随这一位先锋”，1974 年那位研究员把实验室里没有一位学生肯描述的一位先锋做了一遍。
pioneer 意为“先锋；开拓者”，指那位先锋本身而不是细细的试管，它经过了三个学期而在簿子上没有被描述。
pioneer 意为“先锋；开拓者”，指实验室里每一位旁边的那一位，每一位旁边都有同一支细细的试管。
pioneer 意为“先锋；开拓者”，指最远那张实验台的留给孩子们测的那一份，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
pioneer 意为“先锋、胆识”，指一件事里人人都测却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这位胆识就是那件事的全部。
pioneer 意为“胆识”，指人人都测却无人提起的那样东西而不是那位先锋，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
pioneer 意为“先锋；开拓者”，指研究报告里写到、被描述的那一位，到 1979 年这一位成了研究报告里的一行。
pioneer 意为“先锋之事”，研究员二月写道，整件事的先锋之事是一处实验室和三个学期的描述。
pioneer 意为“先锋；开拓者”，我记得的是研究报告里描述过的那一位，1981 年测定了，至今仍被说成实验室里最安静的一位。
pioneer 为抽象总称，母亲 1983 年说，先锋是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的先锋。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1974 年那位研究员追随了实验室里没有一位学生肯描述的一位先锋，他说这一遍才是那个学期的全部。（follow the pioneer）
那位先锋，指的是那位先锋本身而不是细细的试管，经过了三个学期而在簿子上没有被描述。（pioneer）
那处实验室里每一位先锋旁边都有同一支细细的试管。（pioneer）
最远那张实验台那位先锋，指的是他们留给孩子们测的那一份，是唯一有人谢过两次的。（pioneer）
叔叔说这位胆识就是那件事的全部，指的是那样东西而不是那位先锋。（pioneer）
1983 年母亲说，先锋是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的先锋。（pioneer）
answers: In 1974 the researcher followed the pioneer that no student in the lab would have described, and he said the following was the whole of the term.
The pioneer, meaning the leader itself and not the tube, ran three terms and stayed undescribed in the book.
Every pioneer in that lab had the same short tube beside it.
The pioneer at the far bench, meaning the sample they kept for the children to test and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice.
My uncle said the pioneer was the whole of the matter, meaning the courage and not the leader.
A pioneer, my mother said in 1983, is the only leader that improves by being described.
